function.description: Get ONE Virtuals agent token's full profile by its numeric id. Adds to the list fields: factory, category, fdvInVirtual, liquidityUsd, graduation state, launchInfo, a bounded tokenomics summary, a sanitized short description excerpt, and a tradingRoute hint {venue, namespace, quoteToken} naming the EXACT existing tool that trades it (uniswap/kyberswap/solana, quoted in VIRTUAL). ALWAYS call this before buying a graduated agent to read the anti-sniper window — never buy while windowActive. Read-only.
function.name: virtuals__agent_get

id.description: Numeric Virtuals agent id, exactly as virtuals.list returns it (e.g. 96200 for VEX). The string spelling "96200" is accepted too.
